newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-LALAS SCORES AND IS ALSO SENT OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LALAS SCORES AND IS ALSO SENT OFF.

text.p: Alexi Lalas scored a first-half goal and was sent off just before the end as his United States team drew 1-1 with China in a soccer friendly on Saturday.
The veteran Lalas's dismissal came eight minutes from the finish when he received his second yellow card of the match.
Lalas had put the Americans in front in the 24th minute, heading home from a corner.
The U.S. advantage lasted only eight minutes before Su Maozhen headed the equaliser from a pass by Pen Weiguo in a Chinese counter-attack.
China dominated the second half, keeping their opponents on the defensive.

Their best chance came in the 82nd minute through a solo run by Li Jinyun in which he eluded several defenders before Lalas brought him down with a tackle that earned the American his second caution and subsequent sending off.
The 10-man American side, beaten 2-1 by China in their first match in Kunming on Wednesday, held out for the final few minutes.
